hook.en: Your heart beats about 100 000 times a day, pushing 5 litres of blood around 100 000 km of blood vessels — enough to circle the Earth twice. And if you cut your finger, the blood clots in minutes.
hook.bm: Jantung anda berdegup kira-kira 100 000 kali sehari, mengepam 5 liter darah melalui 100 000 km salur darah — cukup untuk mengelilingi Bumi dua kali. Dan jika jari terluka, darah membeku dalam beberapa minit.

bigIdeas.en: Large animals need a circulatory system: open (insects) or closed (fish, humans).
bigIdeas.bm: Haiwan besar memerlukan sistem peredaran: terbuka (serangga) atau tertutup (ikan, manusia).

bigIdeas.en: Humans have a double circulation: pulmonary (heart–lungs) and systemic (heart–body).
bigIdeas.bm: Manusia mempunyai peredaran ganda dua: pulmonari (jantung–peparu) dan sistemik (jantung–badan).

bigIdeas.en: The heartbeat starts at the SA node (pacemaker); valves keep blood flowing one way.
bigIdeas.bm: Degupan jantung bermula di nodus SA (perentak); injap memastikan darah mengalir sehala.

bigIdeas.en: Blood clots through a cascade: platelets → thromboplastin → thrombin → fibrin.
bigIdeas.bm: Darah membeku melalui rangkaian: platlet → tromboplastin → trombin → fibrin.

bigIdeas.en: The lymphatic system returns tissue fluid to the blood and helps fight infection.
bigIdeas.bm: Sistem limfa mengembalikan bendalir tisu ke darah dan membantu melawan jangkitan.

definition.en: Carries blood away from the heart; thick muscular elastic wall, high pressure.
definition.bm: Membawa darah keluar dari jantung; dinding tebal berotot dan kenyal, tekanan tinggi.

definition.en: Carries blood back to the heart; thin wall, valves, low pressure.
definition.bm: Membawa darah kembali ke jantung; dinding nipis, injap, tekanan rendah.

definition.en: Tiny vessel one cell thick where substances are exchanged.
definition.bm: Salur kecil setebal satu sel tempat pertukaran bahan berlaku.

definition.en: Group of cells in the right atrium that starts each heartbeat.
definition.bm: Sekumpulan sel di atrium kanan yang memulakan setiap degupan jantung.

definition.en: Insoluble protein threads that trap blood cells to form a clot.
definition.bm: Bebenang protein tidak larut yang memerangkap sel darah membentuk beku.

definition.en: Fluid that leaks from capillaries and bathes cells.
definition.bm: Bendalir yang meresap keluar dari kapilari dan memandikan sel.

definition.en: Molecule on a cell surface that triggers an immune response (e.g. A, B antigens).
definition.bm: Molekul pada permukaan sel yang mencetuskan gerak balas imun (cth. antigen A, B).

question.en: A person with blood group O needs a transfusion. Which blood groups can they receive?
question.bm: Seseorang berdarah kumpulan O memerlukan pemindahan darah. Kumpulan darah manakah boleh diterima?

steps.en: Group O red cells have no A or B antigens; the plasma has both anti-A and anti-B antibodies.
steps.bm: Sel merah kumpulan O tiada antigen A atau B; plasma mempunyai kedua-dua antibodi anti-A dan anti-B.

steps.en: If donor blood has A or B antigens, the recipient's antibodies make it clump (agglutinate).
steps.bm: Jika darah penderma mempunyai antigen A atau B, antibodi penerima menyebabkannya bergumpal (aglutinasi).

steps.en: So only group O blood (no antigens) is safe.
steps.bm: Jadi hanya darah kumpulan O (tiada antigen) yang selamat.

answer.en: Only group O. (Group O is the universal donor; AB is the universal recipient.)
answer.bm: Hanya kumpulan O. (Kumpulan O penderma universal; AB penerima universal.)

prompt.en: Insects have an open circulatory system. This means…
prompt.bm: Serangga mempunyai sistem peredaran terbuka. Ini bermakna…

options.en: blood (haemolymph) flows freely in body cavities, not always in vessels
options.bm: darah (hemolimfa) mengalir bebas dalam rongga badan, tidak sentiasa dalam salur

options.en: blood carries oxygen to every cell
options.bm: darah membawa oksigen ke setiap sel

explanation.en: In insects O₂ is delivered by the tracheal system; haemolymph carries nutrients.
explanation.bm: Dalam serangga O₂ dihantar oleh sistem trakea; hemolimfa membawa nutrien.

prompt.en: Match each blood vessel to its feature.
prompt.bm: Padankan setiap salur darah dengan cirinya.

explanation.en: Arteries away, veins back, capillaries exchange.
explanation.bm: Arteri keluar, vena kembali, kapilari bertukar bahan.

prompt.en: Why is the wall of the left ventricle thicker than the right ventricle?
prompt.bm: Mengapa dinding ventrikel kiri lebih tebal daripada ventrikel kanan?

options.en: It pumps blood to the whole body at high pressure
options.bm: Ia mengepam darah ke seluruh badan pada tekanan tinggi

options.en: It receives blood from the lungs

explanation.en: The right ventricle only pumps to the nearby lungs.
explanation.bm: Ventrikel kanan hanya mengepam ke peparu yang berdekatan.

prompt.en: Which blood vessel carries oxygenated blood from the lungs to the heart?
prompt.bm: Salur darah manakah membawa darah beroksigen dari peparu ke jantung?

explanation.en: It's the only vein carrying oxygenated blood; the pulmonary artery is the only artery carrying deoxygenated blood.
explanation.bm: Satu-satunya vena yang membawa darah beroksigen; arteri pulmonari satu-satunya arteri membawa darah terdeoksigen.

prompt.en: Put the spread of the heartbeat signal in order.

items.en: Bundle of His and Purkinje fibres

explanation.en: The delay lets atria empty before ventricles contract from the bottom upwards.
explanation.bm: Kelengahan membolehkan atrium kosong sebelum ventrikel mengecut dari bawah ke atas.

prompt.en: Arrange the steps of blood clotting.

items.en: Platelets and damaged tissue release thromboplastin
items.bm: Platlet dan tisu rosak membebaskan tromboplastin

items.en: Prothrombin → thrombin (needs Ca²⁺ and vitamin K)
items.bm: Protrombin → trombin (perlu Ca²⁺ dan vitamin K)

items.en: Fibrin threads trap blood cells → clot
items.bm: Bebenang fibrin memerangkap sel darah → beku

explanation.en: Haemophilia is a genetic disorder where a clotting factor is missing.
explanation.bm: Hemofilia ialah penyakit genetik akibat kekurangan faktor pembekuan.

prompt.en: Which blood group is the universal recipient?

explanation.en: AB plasma has no anti-A or anti-B antibodies, so it won't attack donor red cells.
explanation.bm: Plasma AB tiada antibodi anti-A atau anti-B, jadi tidak menyerang sel merah penderma.

options.en: fatty deposits (plaque) building up in artery walls
options.bm: mendapan lemak (plak) terkumpul dalam dinding arteri

explanation.en: Plaque narrows arteries, raising blood pressure and the risk of heart attack and stroke.
explanation.bm: Plak menyempitkan arteri, menaikkan tekanan darah dan risiko serangan jantung serta strok.

prompt.en: What is the main function of the lymphatic system?

options.en: Return tissue fluid to the blood and help defend the body
options.bm: Mengembalikan bendalir tisu ke darah dan membantu mempertahankan badan

explanation.en: Lymph nodes filter bacteria; lacteals also absorb fats.
explanation.bm: Nodus limfa menapis bakteria; lakteal juga menyerap lemak.

options.en: tissue fluid builds up because it isn't drained by lymph vessels
options.bm: bendalir tisu terkumpul kerana tidak disalirkan oleh salur limfa

explanation.en: Blocked lymph vessels (e.g. filariasis/elephantiasis caused by worms spread by mosquitoes) cause severe oedema.
explanation.bm: Salur limfa tersumbat (cth. filariasis/untut akibat cacing yang disebarkan nyamuk) menyebabkan edema teruk.
